description: Standard time-value-of-money arithmetic for an ordinary annuity (contributions at the end of each month, compounded monthly). Mode "time-to-goal" solves for how many months it takes to reach a savings goal given a fixed monthly contribution; mode "contribution-for-target" solves for the monthly contribution required to reach the goal in a given number of months. Pure closed-form formulas, no live rate data.

annualInterestRatePercent.description: Nominal annual interest rate as a percent, compounded monthly (cannot be negative)

goalAmount.description: The target savings amount (must be greater than zero)

monthlyContribution.description: Required for mode "time-to-goal": the fixed amount contributed each month

months.description: Required for mode "contribution-for-target": the target number of months (positive integer)

name: calculate_savings_goal
